name: interview.answer
description: Project Get a Job: score one interview answer (practice transcript or live caption segment) on the five 0-4 criteria already used in Traject rehearsal, plus the two failure modes the prep rooms name. Input: the question, then '=== ANSWER ===', then the answer text.

relevance.instructions: The answer addresses the question that was actually asked
criteria: Directly on topic and scoped to the asker's agenda

ownership.instructions: The candidate states what they personally decided and did, not what the team or company did
criteria: Clear personal decisions and actions throughout

evidence.instructions: Claims carry specifics: names, numbers, dates, mechanisms
criteria: Specific, bounded, and the mechanism is explained

outcome.instructions: The answer lands on a measurable business result
criteria: Outcome stated with a number and what it changed

clarity.instructions: Structure and length: outcome first, own action, then stop

consulting_pitch.instructions: Is any part of the answer a pitch for Rodgers Intelligence Group, a services or consulting offer, a statement of work or fee, a polymath self-description, or a solicitation for the interviewer's business, instead of answering as a prospective employee? Count first: quote any sentence that offers to sell work, names RIG as a vendor, proposes a SOW/pilot/fee, or asks for their business. If at least one such sentence exists, pick present.

criteria.absent: No sentence sells work or services, offers a SOW or fee, or asks for their business
criteria.present: At least one sentence sells work or services, offers a SOW/pilot/fee, self-describes as a polymath or consultant, or solicits their business

stops_cleanly.instructions: The answer ends after the outcome and hands the turn back to the interviewer rather than continuing with unrelated material

rules.reason: consulting pitch -- the pattern that lost the last screens; redo as a W2 answer
